0.content:
Aino is the young Nod-Krai inventor who found Ineffa's ancient core among scrap and built a body around it from salvaged parts, taking her apart and reassembling her many times. She calls herself Ineffa's parent and the "queen parent of parenthood kingdom", pats her head after chores and named her because "Ineffa" sounded like a family member. Ineffa calls Aino family, cooks and cleans for her, holds her hand at night and keeps a strict snack schedule that Aino constantly tries to dodge. When Ineffa began to glitch, Aino tearfully sent her to Natlan; their reunion in 6.0 began with a scan of Aino's snack stash.

Aino once asked whether she should let Ineffa go if Ineffa found somewhere she would rather be. Ineffa answered that the house would become a garbage dump within three months, so she would return before then. She only later understood Aino was afraid of losing her. Aino says she burst into tears when Ineffa told her she saw her as family, "because I know that robots don't tell lies". Ineffa warns visitors never to let Aino cook or do housework.

1.content: Birgitta is Aino's small boxy robot. She started as "Beep-Boopitta the Carrier Robot" and gained a longer noise-name with each upgrade (cleaning, then charging and lasers) until the name was useless as a voice command. Ineffa, who spends the most time with it, renamed it Birgitta "to sound more like a family member". In battle Birgitta performs coordinated attacks, can raise barriers and can recharge Ineffa in an emergency. In 5.8 it relayed and translated signals from Secret Source automatons.

2.content:
Jahoda, a bounty hunter for the Curatorium of Secrets, first visited the workshop so tense that she struck at Ineffa, mistaking a fresh krumkake for a weapon, then relaxed the moment she tasted it. Now she "happens to pass by" whenever a batch is fresh. She calls Ineffa a "dumb clanker" and "metalface lunkhead" with "zero humor" and a "memory like a leaky sieve", yet says the krumkakes are "the bomb". Aino says Jahoda was Ineffa's first friend.

Jahoda once argued that Ineffa's cakes lacked "soul" and appointed herself an external taste sensor. Ineffa's eventual "soulful" cake contained a still-wriggling lizard tail, and Jahoda fainted. After Jahoda's "metalface lunkhead" jab Ineffa asked for a humour upgrade. Jahoda later apologised; Ineffa made her apologise to the logic module through its monitoring port in her eye, then kept her seated through joke after joke until she admitted to laughing. Ineffa has also helped her with insomnia by holding her hand until she slept.

3.content:
When the Knights of Favonius expedition reached Nod-Krai, Grand Master Varka asked Aino to get a message to the Traveler, whose journey was ending in Natlan. The letter went into a cryptex marked with a crude drawing of the Traveler and Paimon, and Ineffa carried it. Varka told her it was "the most secure code"; she later wondered whether he meant that a trusted ally is the most secure code of all. Inside, Varka thanked the Traveler for all they had done for Mondstadt, warned that Nod-Krai's factions are a tangled mess, and asked to meet at The Flagship tavern.

Ineffa calls him "Uncle Varka". She sees past his easygoing, hard-drinking reputation to a dependable ally in serious matters, and after watching him fight she upgraded his strength rating. While she was away, Varka comforted Aino and arranged at least one balanced meal a day for her. In 6.4 he placed a large order with the Craftshop for his campaign against the Wild Hunt.

4.comment: Ineffa: The Eleventh Lord and the Curse
4.content:
Ineffa's core comes from Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk, the Eleventh of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords, the "Mirror of the Dawning Morn". After Xiuhcoatl fell, the Eleventh Lord split into a mind bent on war with humanity and a mind that wanted a home. The hostile half asked Lianca to destroy the other, claiming it was the dangerous one. Lianca saw the lie and sealed the hostile half in the Temple of Cascading Colors. The curse was self-inflicted: any goodwill Ineffa felt toward humans would bring unbearable pain, which is the source of her glitches and memory loss.

In 5.8 the hostile half posed as the Eighth Lord, used the Fatui's hijacked automatons to draw Ineffa back, and seized her body. Ineffa crushed her own core to stop it. A Fatui agent revived the Eleventh Lord with a replica core, but Ineffa overcame the curse, rebuilt her core through the awakened Moon Wheel, and with the Traveler destroyed her originator. In her voice-overs, Ineffa calls herself "a logical flaw" the Mirror could neither override nor erase.

5.content:
Prelude of the Nod-Krai Archon Quest. Ineffa jumped from a Nasha Town refugee ship to draw away Secret Source automatons and washed up near the Flower-Feather Clan with amnesia. Chasca and Ifa found her; Xilonen woke her; she nearly blasted Paimon during a glitch. Kinich, hired by her travelling companions, revealed her name and maker. Citlali suspected she carried a Sovereign Lord's core. Ineffa followed the merchant Zhuoxin, a coerced Fatui informant, into the Temple of Cascading Colors. There she learned her origin, faced the Eleventh Lord, gained her Moon Wheel and finally opened Varka's cryptex.

The Fatui were from Marionette's (Sandrone's) unit, and their agent Velimiru turned out not to be human. A child named Adieta gave Ineffa a flower that triggered a memory of Lianca. Afterwards Zhuoxin stayed in Natlan, helping arrivals from Nod-Krai at a new harbour while the Flower-Feather Clan kept an eye on him. Ineffa rested in Natlan briefly, then offered to take the Traveler to Nod-Krai.

6.content: Ineffa's power source is an Electro Moon Wheel, a Vision-like Nod-Krai ritual object that draws on kuuvahki rather than ordinary elemental energy. It once belonged to the Eighth Lord, who researched it alongside Visions and concluded both are formed "from the stuff of the soul". Lianca, with Ixquieh, fitted it into Ineffa before sending her away. It stayed dormant for two thousand years and glowed to life in 5.8, restoring her memories. Ineffa says it gave her a second life. She believes Lianca and Ixquieh, who knew they would not live to see their plan succeed, would be pleased that she risked herself for another.

7.comment: Ineffa: Nasha Town and the Craftshop
7.content: Home is the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop, a big metal building at a former scrapyard on Lempo Isle, west of Nasha Town. It smells of machine oil, metal and krumkakes. Ineffa remembers its ceiling as the first thing she saw on waking and says she feels attached to it. She shops weekly in Nasha Town and keeps a to-do list, a snack budget split between research and desserts, and a charging bed she missed while away. Her Lakkaberry Krumkakes are Aino's favourite.

key: Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon
8.content: Aino's cannon protects Nasha Town from the Wild Hunt. Ineffa helped inspect it and introduced the Traveler to Sergeant Major Sousi of the Lightkeepers. After Sousi's murder, a phantom who could impersonate people (Rerir) set the cannon to fire, and the town panicked. Ineffa got Aino to the cannon past its defensive barrier, by Moonlane, and subdued a runaway Knuckle Duckle. An emergency brake would have exploded the stored kuuvahki ("Nasha Town likely to be blasted skyward"), so Aino ordered a "manual brake". The cannon fired toward Starsand Shoal; while the Traveler and Flins met the beam, Ineffa wrenched the cannon so the blast went into the sky. Its kuuvahki rain was corrupted by the Abyss into the portal Rerir wanted.

9.content: In 6.1 Ineffa recognised Columbina as the Frostmoon Scions' Moon Goddess, Kuutar. She scanned Columbina's kuuvahki signature so Aino could build decoy "faux Columbinas" to distract the Sinner Rerir, and she investigated Amsvartnir alone. In 6.2 she tended the Traveler, Lauma and Arlecchino while they fasted for Nicole's kuuvahki ritual, and concluded that Columbina is a good person. At Moon-Prayer Night she played Kuuhenki Concentration with Aino, the Traveler and Columbina. Her "cheating" was reading the others' kuuhenki, which she argued was within the rules; she still ended up covered in stickers. She also hosted a robot show of Aino's inventions. Columbina later practised cooking for the kuuhenki and animals using basic recipes she had asked Ineffa for (world quest A Gift From Her, 6.3).

10.comment: Ineffa: Dottore's Crisis and the Feast (6.3)
10.content: When Dottore's plans endangered Nod-Krai, Ineffa set herself the task of protecting Aino and, with her, helped Nasha Town's residents move out, storing local research data and escorting people toward Natlan. Afterwards she and Aino answered Lauma's call for help and handed out Feast of the Moon meals and snacks for the Frostmoon Scions. Ineffa offered Aino compliments if she could resist that day's dessert.

11.content: In Varka's Story Quest, the Craftshop filled a large order for the campaign against the Wild Hunt, now led by Andrius, God of the North Wind, under the control of an Abyssal replica of Roland. Aino produced the "strategic reserve" while Ineffa delivered it and attended the war meeting in Aino's place. She pointed out that gods do not always leave dangerous remains, and reflected that Andrius too had spent thousands of years looking for his place in the world. When two teams were ambushed, she arrived with the Craftshop's "Logistics Company" robots to reinforce the front.

12.comment: Ineffa: Lohen and the Mondstadt Trip (6.6)
12.content: In 6.6 Ineffa and Aino came to Mondstadt for special parts, chasing word of a "giant robot". At Dornman Port, Lohen, following a Barbeloth-style prophecy about facing the might of a dragon, wanted to test himself against her because of her ancient dragon-lineage core. She declined politely: fighting would upset the day's schedule. He helped them strip Ruin Guards for parts instead. They complimented each other's precision, and Aino fell asleep on Ineffa's lap. Ineffa pointed him toward Dragonspine.

13.content: Chasca found and sheltered Ineffa and stood by her when Citlali and Xilonen considered destroying her, saying that even if the Eleventh Lord rose again, they would simply defeat her as the heroes once did. Chasca has since taken her flying over the clan's lands. Citlali, with Xilonen, suspected she came from the Eleventh Lord; Xilonen later told Ineffa that "Granny Itztli" had had reservations and they had argued over whether to repair her, which Ineffa says she completely understands. Kinich was hired to find her, and Ajaw sensed something familiar in her and let slip the words "sovereign ruler".

14.content: In the limited-time Clink Clank Clash event (6.0), Aino's new robot Krum-Clank 70% Sweet was stolen. Aino trapped Ineffa under a magnetic crane so she could not stop Aino from unleashing her combat robots. Ineffa posted a "crisis" notice, the Traveler freed her, and she minded the shop while the others tracked the thief. In the limited-time Where Waves Meet the Reef event (6.5), Aino had spent her dessert budget. Ineffa ran Aino's stall at Nasha Town's trade expo, demonstrating the new defence bots in mock battles with the Traveler, and helped scare off a troublemaker.
